work.composition: central plane on light field, dense base frieze
work.description: Mixed-media collage centered on a top-down line-drawn warplane over layered CD-R packaging, holographic foil, and iridescent tape. Four Skilcraft compact discs are affixed at corners; a football, red helmet, paper clips, and concentric target forms occupy the lower register alongside yellow-accented gear shapes.
work.title: Fuselage and Helmet
